fields.name: CurrentLeaderEpoch
fields.about: The current leader epoch of the partition, -1 for unknown leader epoch.

fields.name: VoterId
fields.about: The replica id of the voter getting updated in the topic partition.

fields.name: VoterDirectoryId
fields.about: The directory id of the voter getting updated in the topic partition.

fields.name: Listeners
fields.about: The endpoint that can be used to communicate with the leader.

fields.name: KRaftVersionFeature
fields.about: The range of versions of the protocol that the replica supports.

fields.name: MinSupportedVersion
fields.about: The minimum supported KRaft protocol version.

fields.name: MaxSupportedVersion
fields.about: The maximum supported KRaft protocol version.
